title: Fuego Down Pant - Men's
description: Great for winter bonfires, ice fishing at the lake, or any cold weather activity, the Fuego Down Pant is a playful new take on our quintessential insulation layer. Made with responsibly sourced 800-fill down and a water-resistant DWR-finished shell, this lightweight pant is one we love for winter wandering. Packs into the wearer's right pocket.

title: Rayu Rain Jacket - Women's
description: A tried and true rain shell built for slick city streets, the Rayu Rain Jacket has you covered around town. With two zippered hand pockets and a cinchable hood, this fully waterproof shell has all the features you need and none that you don't.

title: Sombra Sun Hoodie - Men's
description: A classic fit plus UPF 50+ sun protection makes the Sombra Sun Hoodie perfect for throwing over a t-shirt when high noon approaches. A sunny adventure staple with UPF 50+ protection.

title: Pacaya Lite Hooded Jacket - Men's
description: For spring wind and breezy summits, throw on the Pacaya Lite Hooded Jacket so you can fully enjoy the view. Built entirely from super lightweight recycled nylon, this breathes well on the way up, and offers protection when you need it.

title: Solta Long-Sleeve Sun Shirt - Men's
description: From desert hikes to dense rainforests, the Solta Long-Sleeve Sun Shirt is ready for a trip off the beaten path. With built-in UPF 50+ protection, quick-dry recycled nylon fabric, and back ventilation for breathability, this shirt keeps you comfortable wherever your trail leads.

title: Losdos Zip-Off Pant - Women's
description: The mountains are unpredictable, which is why we love the versatility of the trail-ready Losdos Zip-Off Pants. Stretchy, moisture-wicking, with UPF 50+ protection. Zip off the legs to transform into four-inch shorts, and the zip-off bottoms pack into the cargo pockets for easy storage.

title: Down Mitten
description: Get ready for the softest high fives ever, our Down Mitten features a cozy fleece lining and responsibly sourced down to keep your hands happy this winter. With a water-resistant exterior and elastic wrist binding, this mitten performs when snow starts falling, too.

title: Teca Fleece Beanie
description: We took the coziness and resourcefulness of our bestselling Teca Fleece and turned it into a beanie for chillier days.

title: Todo 2L Hip Pack - Cada Día
description: Downtown, school, or trail, this hip pack is your outfit completer and trusty companion for it all. With a 2L main compartment and interior slip pocket, it fits all your necessities of life. Wear as a hip pack or cross body as a sling, designed for urban adventures, festivals, and hands-free exploration.

title: Todo Water Bottle Sling
description: Throw the Todo Water Bottle Sling over your shoulder and enjoy endlessly hydrated adventures. This 2-liter crossbody sling keeps a 32oz water bottle within arms reach, with a front zippered pocket and back mesh pocket to stash a phone, snack, or sunnies. Adds versatility to hikes, city wandering, and outdoor concerts.

title: Tasra 16L Backpack
description: This feature-forward pack was designed with the minimalist traveler in mind. Spacious compartments, a full-wrap zippered opening, a variety of organizational pockets, and a padded laptop sleeve. The backpack straps tuck away to convert into a briefcase-style carry.

title: Tech Plus 5-Panel Hat
description: With our most technical trail hat yet, long hikes and trail runs are a breeze. Built with ultra-lightweight recycled polyester fabric and perforated sides for extra breathability. The unstructured design makes it easy to smush down and toss in a pack or pocket.
